# Carcavelos Daily Brief – 5 July 2026

**Tiny, glassy start – a perfect dawn patrol day if you're keen.**

Early morning offers the cleanest window, with light SW winds and 0.6–0.7m waves until around 07:00. Swell is soft and slow (5.75–6.05s), so expect mushier, longer rides rather than crisp barrels. By 10:00–11:00 the air warms significantly (28°C+) and winds shift NE—still light, still good.

The afternoon deteriorates slightly: winds pick up to 6–9km/h from the south by 13:00, adding chop. Swell stretches to 8s+ (cleaner but slower), and wave heights fade to 0.56m—barely shoulder-high.

**Go early or skip it.** Sunrise to 08:00 is your window. Bring a shortboard or funboard for these mushers. Avoid the 13:00–16:00 wind window unless you just want to cool off.
